items.briefing:
Two Western Australian men have been arrested and charged following a joint investigation by the Australian Federal Police, FBI, and WA Police Force into an alleged open-source supply-chain attack linked to the "TeamPCP" hacking group. This is a reminder that cyber threats aren't always from overseas — local actors can compromise widely-used software tools that organisations rely on daily.

Separately, Bitdefender is warning of school-themed scams targeting the Asia-Pacific region, which are likely to affect Australian students, parents, and education staff including those at training organisations like ours. Be cautious of unsolicited emails or messages related to enrolments, fees, or educational offers.

**Tip:** If you receive unexpected emails about school or course fees, verify directly with the organisation before clicking any links or making payments.

featured.title: Bitdefender warns of school scams across Asia-Pacific
